text:
Jamal: Heads up — two panels last night had no scorecard link on the invite UI, so several interviewers couldn't submit. Noticed around 7am in the recruiting inbox.

Liz: ugh. which panels? any pattern (region/model/slot)?

Jamal: Candidate IDs: C-4217, C-4219. Both were panel interviews scheduled via ATS sync from GH. Timezones were mixed (APAC panelist included). Recruiters flagged missing 'Eval form' link in invite.

Taylor: I can repro locally — GH webhook is sending event payload where `custom_fields.scorecard_template` is null for those panels. a snippet:

```
"custom_fields": {
  "scorecard_template": null,
  "panel_owner": "recruiter@redwood.com"
}
```

Anya: That matches 1 inbox report. Also noticed calendar shows double-book for one interviewer: two invites created (same slot), one with scorecard, one without.

Mohan: Eng looking. Probably duplicate create flow — one from "panel create" and one from "slot autoassign". I'll push a quick guard to dedupe on GH event id and ensure we attach template id before creating calendar invite.

Liz: short-term workaround?

Mohan: Ops can run manual attach script to patch invites for today's panels. I have a script:

```
# attach_scorecard.py
for invite in invites:
  if not invite.metadata.scorecard and invite.panel_id in panel_map:
    invite.attach_scorecard(panel_map[invite.panel_id])
```

I'll run it after PR merges.

Jamal: Can we backfill submissions missing? some interviewers submitted via email but not linked to candidate record.

Anya: Recruiters can collect PDF scorecards and I'll upload then link manually — but it'd be 30+ items.

Taylor: Suggestion: add validation in ATS sync to reject creates where scorecard_template is missing; fallback to default template id=default-ops-1.

Mohan: Agree. I'll add fallback and dedupe. ETA for fix: EOD today if no surprises. Will post PR link.

Liz: thx. can you also add monitoring metric for "invites without scorecard" so we catch early?

Mohan: yes — adding counter+alert to recruiting dashboard.

recruiter-bot: Reminder: if you need mass backfill, open ticket with Subject "Backfill: ScorecardAttach" and include runbook.

Jamal: ok I'll coordinate with recruiters and schedule a 30min runbook call at 10:30.

Liz: assign to Jamal + Anya. ping when done. :thumbsup:
